_about: What a trait's GRADE means, per effect shape (docs/alchemy-revamp-plan.md §6.2;
contracts §1 row F). Same-named traits from distinct materials merge and their grades
add (Atelier: Ryza, 'Critical Lv 2 and a Critical Lv 5 will yield a Critical Lv 7'),
capped by the Alchemist level. A grade is read here, never stored as a number on a
product: the product record keeps ids and grades, and rules/alchemy_items.build turns
them into documents on read (contracts §6). Every value is PROPOSED in plan §6.2 and
tunable here without a code change.
Two traits are the same trait when their type, their target (a damage's type, a
condition, a save, a skill...) and their route agree (plan §6.2): fire damage struck
and fire resistance drunk are two traits, two fire-damage traits are one.
_cap: The highest grade a merge reaches: the Alchemist level (plan §6.2, proposed). At Alchemist 1 nothing merges past grade 1; endless levels deepen it one step a level.
_dice: Grade g multiplies the dice COUNT (1d6 at grade 3 is 3d6) and any flat part with it.
_amount: A flat amount (a bonus, a resistance, hit points healed) is g x the amount; a penalty grows in magnitude the same way.
_save_dc: A save's DC rises 2 for each grade above 1.
_condition_duration: A condition's duration is g x as long.
_bonus_duration: Any other duration is the longest of the merged traits', never multiplied: a stronger draught, not a longer one.
_unscaled_types: Shapes a grade adds nothing to: a light's radius, a cloud's size, a tag granted, a condition lifted. They merge and keep the strongest source's document as it is.
